title: orbitals
description: this adds a way to get overpowered weapons that could one shot players in minecraft
body:
this datapack has weapons that hold power no other weapon can

heres why you should download it its a fun way to troll your friends with overpowered weapons and generaly good for fighting worlds

by running /function u can find lots of different items as arrow cannons nuke shot lawnukeshot and stabshot and snowballtntcannon 

like these

/function get_arrow_cannon
/function get_arrow_cannon_shulker
/function get_lawnuke
/function get_lawnuke_shulker
/function get_nuke
/function get_nuke_shulker
/function get_snowballtnt_cannon
/function get_snowballtnt_cannon_shulker
/function get_stab
/function get_stab_shulker

another thing u should get the shulkers if you want to get the items the other ones like get arrow cannon and get snowballtnt cannon would just spawn the things it does but shulkers have the items so yeah but the stab and nuke shot and lawnuke dont so its good

have fun with this datapack id love to update this as much as i could
